app.name: LightCast Cast Receiver
app.tagline: Turn your PC into a DLNA receiver
home.title: Cast Center
home.tip.title: How to cast?
home.tip.body: From your phone's Cast or DLNA app (e.g. BubbleUPnP, VLC, your gallery's Cast, or most anime / video streaming apps), choose the device "{name}" to cast video, music or photos to this PC.
home.tip.no_network: No usable local network address detected. Please check your network connection.
player.empty.hint: Media will play in the player window once you cast from your phone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.service.enabled.hint: Start receiving casts automatically when the app opens — no manual start needed
settings.device_name.hint: Name your phone sees when searching for devices (takes effect after restart)
settings.http_port.hint: 0 = auto-assign, usually no need to change (takes effect after restart)
settings.need_restart: This setting takes effect after restarting the app
settings.about.description: LightCast is an open-source DLNA cast receiver built with PySide6 + libmpv, supporting video, music and photo casting.
dialog.minimize_to_tray.title: Minimize to tray
dialog.minimize_to_tray.body: LightCast will keep running in the background to receive casts. Click the tray icon to reopen the window.
dialog.minimize_to_tray.dont_ask: Don't ask again — minimize to tray directly
dialog.dll_missing.title: Missing libmpv
dialog.dll_missing.body: mpv-2.dll was not found, the player cannot work. Please read README.md, place libmpv's mpv-2.dll into the bin/ folder, then restart.
dialog.restart.title: Restart required
dialog.restart.body: This setting takes effect after restarting LightCast. Restart now?
settings.autostart.hint: Start silently in the background (system tray) after logging into Windows
settings.audio_device.hint: Choose which device plays the sound (refreshes automatically when devices are plugged in or out)
settings.update.hint: Check GitHub for new versions at startup and offer to install (requires network)
dialog.update.available.title: Update available
dialog.update.available.body: LightCast v{version} has been released. Download and install it now?
player.error.play_failed.hint: Check your network connection, or try another quality/source. Details are in the log (lightcast.log).
player.error.hint.forbidden: The source rejected the request (403/410) — the link may be expired or blocked by hotlink protection. Please re-cast.
player.error.hint.not_found: The source reported the resource is missing (404) — the link may have expired. Please re-cast.
player.error.hint.key: Failed to fetch the decryption key — it may be blocked by the source. Try another quality or source.
player.error.hint.invalid: The media content could not be recognized — the source may have returned an error page. Try another quality or source.
player.error.hint.network: Network connection failed or timed out. Check your network and retry.
